text:
maya: Quick heads-up — final pass on changelog entries for the 0.15 release. Cutoff is tomorrow 10:00 PT. If you have an open one-liner, please tidy it now so we can avoid last-minute edits.

sam: Ack. Working through my PRs now, will squash small wording nits.

kai: Do we still want to enforce the component tag prefix? I have a few entries that are vague.

maya: Yes, please. Use the template in docs/release/CHANGELOG.md. We need a clear component and a one-line summary, optional detail line limited to one sentence. Example:```
Component: runtime
One-liner: Improve KV cache eviction to reduce memory pressure
Detail: Fixes a regression where long-running sessions caused unbounded KV growth.
```

sam: Nice example. Will update mine. Any owners for the "bump" PRs? I see a couple merge conflicts queued.

oliver: I'm on bump-versions/* — planning to rebase at 08:00 PT. If you need a quick hand resolving conflicts ping me.

release-bot: :bell: Reminder: changelog cutoff in 12 hours for channel eng-releases. Please ensure PRs are labeled `changelog/ready` or they will be skipped.

kai: One more question — for small infra tweaks that are purely internal, do we prefer concise entries under `infrastructure` or `infra:ops`?

maya: Use `infrastructure` unless there's an obvious subsystem owner. The goal is discoverability for customers scanning release notes.

sam: Re: formatting — can we enforce a maximum one-liner length? Some of mine are getting long.

maya: Let's aim for ~80 chars for the one-liner. If it's longer, shorten to the core user-facing change and put extra context on the detail line.

kai: Cool. I've switched two entries to the template and added component tags. One left to shorten.

oliver: Heads-up: I'll hold the merge queue for bump PRs until 09:30 PT to avoid midnight surprises. If you need a hotfix cherry-pick after that, call it out in the PR title `cherry:urgent`.

sam: Thanks. Also, small lint check: some entries have backticks that break the markdown summary. Avoid inline code in the one-liner unless necessary.

maya: Good catch. I'll do a sweep at 09:00 PT for style nits and mark anything requiring author follow-up as `changelog/needs-edit`.

release-bot: :white_check_mark: Cutoff reminder acknowledged. 6 PRs flagged `changelog/needs-edit`, 4 PRs labeled `changelog/ready`.

maya: Perfect. If anyone can't get to their edits before cutoff, drop a @oliver or @maya in the thread and we'll help condense. After cutoff we'll only accept security/backport fixes with explicit approval.

sam: Sending last updates now. Thanks all.

kai: Done — updated component tags and trimmed one-liner.

oliver: Rebased bump PRs; merging in 15.

maya: Thanks team — final sweep in 30m then I'll close the release notes draft.
